app.name: AquaPulse
app.offline: You are offline. Showing what was loaded before; changes wait until you are back online.

login.title: Log in
login.codeHelp: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for AquaPulse. Lost your phone? Type one of your recovery codes instead.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.help: Type your email. If it belongs to an account, we send a code to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If that account exists, an email with a code is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password is changed. Log in with the new one.

invite.title: Create your account
invite.help: Your building uses AquaPulse. Choose a password to see your water use and bills.

password.help: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words is strong and easy to remember.

home.title: My home
home.noHome: You are not linked to a home yet. Ask your building owner to invite you.
home.deviceOffline: Your water meter has not been heard from since {{when}}. Readings may be old.
home.noDevice: No water meter is installed in your home yet.

quality.title: Water quality
quality.explain: pH says how acidic or alkaline water is, from 0 to 14; 7 is neutral. Drinking water should be between {{low}} and {{high}}. Below that it can taste sour and damage pipes; above that it can taste bitter and leave scale. AquaPulse alerts you and the owner if it stays outside for a few readings.

valve.title: Water supply
valve.confirmOff: Turn off the water in unit {{unit}}? Taps will stop until you turn it on again.
valve.confirmOn: Turn the water in unit {{unit}} back on?
valve.pending: Waiting for the valve to confirm…
valve.failed: The valve did not do it ({{reason}}).
valve.timeout: The valve did not answer in time. Check that the meter is online and try again.
valve.lockedHelp: Only the building owner can change it. Contact them if this is a mistake.
valve.offline: The meter is offline, so the valve cannot be switched now.

usage.title: My usage
usage.noAverage: Shown when at least 3 homes in the building are occupied (so nobody's own use can be worked out).
usage.notHere: You did not live here then.
usage.none: No water used in this period.

bills.title: My bills
bills.none: No bills yet. Bills are made after each month ends.
bills.payHelp: Stripe test mode: no real money. Use card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date and any CVC.
bills.paymentDone: Thank you. Your payment is being confirmed; this bill updates by itself in a moment.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.cleared: Problem gone since {{when}}; closes by itself 10 minutes later.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.changed: Password changed. Please log in again.
profile.logoutAllHelp: Ends every session on all your phones and browsers, including this one.
profile.twoFactorOn: On. Logging in needs your password and a code from your authenticator app.
profile.twoFactorOff: Off. Turn it on so a stolen password alone is not enough.
profile.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator; all free). Or type this key:
profile.enterCode: Type the 6-digit code the app shows
profile.recoveryHelp: Save these now (write them down or keep them in a password manager). Each works once if you lose your phone. They are not shown again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Alerts always show in the app. Here you choose which ones also come by email.
notifications.emailMin: Email me alerts from this level up
notifications.quietHelp: During these hours, non-critical emails wait until the end. Critical alerts (like unsafe water) always come at once.
notifications.push: Phone notifications come with the Android app.

staff.title: Welcome, {{name}}
staff.comingOwner: Your owner screens (building overview, homes, valves, tank, tariffs, bills, residents and devices) are being built in the next part of this milestone. Until then, use Alerts and Profile here, and Swagger for the rest:
staff.comingAdmin: The System Admin console (system health, owners, audit log) is being built in a later part of this milestone. Until then, use Alerts and Profile here, and Swagger for the rest:
